appDescription: Smart Journey tracks navigation destinations and manages restaurant waiting requests after explicit user approval.

function.name: GET_SMART_JOURNEY_STATUS
function.description: Get the current journey status and any pending question that needs a voice response.

function.name: RESPOND_SMART_JOURNEY_PROMPT
function.description: Respond to a NEW explicit user answer to the current Smart Journey question. First obtain questionToken from GET_SMART_JOURNEY_STATUS. Never invent a token or reuse an earlier answer.

decision.description: approve when the user clearly says yes (for example 응, 네, 걸어 줘), defer when the user says no or later (for example 아니, 나중에).

questionToken.description: Copy data.questionToken EXACTLY from the latest asking response. It is a single-use value for that question, not a user-supplied or invented question ID. If absent or unknown, get the current question again; do not approve.
